My name is Loh Pheu Ziang, aged 28, a native

My name is Zing Ziang Sung. I am aged 45,
a native of Changchow, and residing at 24 Yeh Tun Li
( 怡德里 ), Yangtszepoo Road. At present I am an
employee of the Huh Kee ( 合記 ) Nail Barrel Factory,
Brenan Road, O.O.L.

At 1 p.m. May 23, Chiang Siao Koo ( 蒋小古 ),
a worker of the Soong Zung Shing ( 宋顺兴 ) Nail Barrel
Factory, Penang Road, off Robison Road, called at the
Huh Kee Nail Barrel Factory, where I was employed. He
announced that the workers in the trade intended to ask
for an increase in wages to cope with the present high
cost of living and that a meeting had been convened for
2 p.m. in the Yin Chung Tien ( 壹中天 ) Tea Shop, Hokien
Road, to discuss the matter. He requested the workers
to attend. At 2 p.m. 23-5-40, I proceeded to the said
tea shop, where some 50 workers had already gathered.

During the meeting the following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-

1. That a demand be submitted for an increase from 6 cents
to 12 cents per barrel made.

2. That handbills be printed requesting the employers
to give a reply to the demand within three days,
failing which a strike be declared on June 1.

3. That workers of each factory appoint one or two delegates
to take up the matter of the demand.

I was appointed as representative of the workers of the
Huh Kee Factory.

会议期间讨论并通过了以下决议：-

1. 提出将每只桶的工资从6分增加到12分的要求。

2. 印发传单，要求雇主在三天内对这一要求给予答复，否则将于6月1日宣布罢工。

3. 每家工厂的工人推选一至两名代表负责处理此项要求事宜。

我被推选为合记厂工人的代表。

At 3 p.m. 11/6/40, on instructions of one named Fong Chi Tong (方志東), an official of the Chinese Workers Welfare Association, No. 127 Rangoon Road, the three accused together with two others (not arrested) named Woo Sai Dur (胡瑞華) and Woo Hai Ling (吳海林) and several others unknown workers entered the Dah Lee Tsang (大李昌) Nail Box Factory, No. 624 Whashing Road, and ordered the workers to cease work and demand from the management that they be paid at least 12 cents for every box made. When the workers refused to cease work, stating that they were satisfied with their increase, the three accused and their accomplices then took away the workers' tools thereby preventing them from working and dragged two workers named Siao San Ts (小三子) and Ling Fah (林發) out of the factory on to the roadway.
The three accused have been charged with Offence Against Public Order and Intimidation and will appear before the S.S.D. Court on the 12/6/40 when a remand will be requested to enable detectives to effect the arrest of the accomplices.
